notes.title: Update X is LIVE + Contest
notes.content:
[b]The long awaited content update for ClusterPuck 99 is now live with lots of great surprises![/b] 

We’re calling this the X update because it brings all the features from the console version to PC. Additionally, we’ve put something secret into the game for players to uncover but more about that below. 

X Update Change list:
[list]
[*]Arena Creator - Build, test and save your own custom levels.
[*]2 brand new maps - Crop Circles and Controllers
[*]Redesigned and refined levels - Tweaks, refinement and balance to existing levels.
[*]Updated level art and UI
[*]New Achievement - "Patience is a Virtue"
[*]Cloud Saving
[*]Windows 10 compatibility fixes
[*]Windows 10 controller fixes (Xbox One and 360)
[*]Added Steam Controller support 
[*]Various bug fixes
[*]Secret Puck Puzzle
[/list]

Ok, now for more information about the Puck Puzzle.

Included in this update is a secret, with clues buried within the game. If you manage to solve the clues and crack the puzzle, a message will appear, and an achievement will unlock.

The first person that uncovers the secret and sends us a picture or screenshot of the message, along with their Steam username, via Twitter wins a [b]$50 Steam Gift Card[/b].

Rules for winning:
[list]
[*]You must be following us on Twitter (@phlcollective).
[*]When sending the picture or screenshot make sure to use the hashtag #PuckPuzzle
[*]Make sure to include your Steam username in the tweet
[*]The winner will be announced on our Twitter page, as well as on the Clusterpuck 99 Steam page
[/list]

Good luck, puckers.

PS - We are working on getting the update ready for Mac and Linux.

notes.title: Update Incoming
notes.content:
Dear ClusterPuck 99 Community,

Before we get into details about the update, I wanted to issue an apology for the lack of communication regarding the timing of our update. We were very vague and non-responsive when you guys were asking questions.

Having said that, we are planning on releasing the free update in the next couple weeks. The update will contain a number of new levels, updated art, updated UI, bug fixes, Win10 compatibility fixes, controller fixes and the much anticipated Arena Creator.

Thank you so much for supporting us and our game. We hope you enjoy the update and continue to support local multiplayer games.

Thanks,
PHL Collective
